subject: Guided erasure confirmation & audit handoff for Zephyr Health
messages:
From: Anita Singh <anita.singh@zephyrhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Guided erasure of historical prompts/outputs and runtime logs

Hi Tessa,

We need to initiate a coordinated erasure for Zephyr Health data in your hosted environment. Scope: prompt inputs, generated outputs, and per-request runtime logs for the tenant IDs ZE-1437 / ZE-1438 for the period Jan 2025 - Aug 2026.

Two asks:
- Confirm your planned workflow (steps you will run and estimated ETA).
- Provide an auditable artifact we can keep (receipt of deleted object IDs + redaction manifest).

Constraints: we need proof that data removed from the live serving layer and KV/prefix caches. For compliance we will accept a CSV manifest + signed receipt. Can you also indicate whether backups/snapshots are affected and the remediation for those?

Attachments: sample_deletion_request_template.csv (we included a short template).

Thanks — appreciate a brief plan and cutover window.

— Anita
Anita Singh
Head of Compliance, Zephyr Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Singh <anita.singh@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Guided erasure of historical prompts/outputs and runtime logs

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear scope. Below is the proposed workflow and timing. Happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer.

Planned workflow (high level):
1) Intake + verification (T+0: 2 hours): confirm tenant IDs / hashes with your team and lock the object list.
2) Snapshot block (T+2: 1 hour): prevent new writes to the specified tenant keys; jobs will operate on a frozen namespace to avoid race conditions.
3) Live-store purge (T+3 to T+6: ~3 hours): remove prompt+output blobs from the serving store using our erasure pipeline (multi-shard delete with verification).
4) KV/prefix cache invalidation (T+6 to T+6:30): explicit eviction of local and global prefix caches; verify cache miss rates for target keys.
5) Backup/snapshot remediation (T+6:30 to T+12): identify snapshots that contain the objects; for snapshot-backed volumes younger than retention horizon we will delete or rekey per policy and reissue a sanitized snapshot.
6) Post-check and manifest generation (T+12 to T+14): run a verification job that returns object IDs and deletion digests; produce CSV receipt and signed PDF.

Estimated total: 12–14 hours from start of the job once we have final confirmation of the full object list. We can compress windows if you need a same-day turnaround but that requires a short maintenance window and acceptance of a higher operational blast radius.

Evidence we will provide:
- redwood_erasure_manifest.csv: list of object IDs and shard locations
- zephyr_audit_receipt.pdf: signed by Ops with deletion digests and timestamp
- optional: a short report (1–2 pages) describing cache eviction logs and snapshot remediation steps

Would you like us to schedule this for tonight at 22:00 PT (to minimize traffic) or tomorrow morning?

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stub: redwood_erasure_manifest.csv (type: text/csv, 3 KB)
From: Anita Singh <anita.singh@zephyrhealth.com>

Thanks Tessa — that plan looks reasonable. We prefer the tonight 22:00 PT window to reduce user impact. A few clarifying items:
- Please confirm when you delete snapshots versus rekeying. Our policy requires permanent removal when retention exceeds our deletion request timeframe.
- For the manifest, can you include a short hash (SHA256) per object so our auditors can independently verify the deletion evidence?
- Can Marissa be the point for signed receipt coordination? She has authority to sign acceptance statements for our records.

If you can confirm the two items above, good to proceed.

— Anita
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anita Singh <anita.singh@zephyrhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: Guided erasure of historical prompts/outputs and runtime logs

On Wed, 30 Sep 2026 12:15:00 -0700, Anita Singh <anita.singh@zephyrhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Tessa — that plan looks reasonable. We prefer the tonight 22:00 PT window to reduce user impact. A few clarifying items:
> - Please confirm when you delete snapshots versus rekeying. Our policy requires permanent removal when retention exceeds our deletion request timeframe.
> - For the manifest, can you include a short hash (SHA256) per object so our auditors can independently verify the deletion evidence?
> - Can Marissa be the point for signed receipt coordination? She has authority to sign acceptance statements for our records.

Hi Anita — I will own the receipt coordination. Quick answers to your clarifying items below, and a note on risk controls.

1) Snapshots: default is to delete any snapshot that solely contains the target objects and is outside retention. If snapshots contain mixed tenant data we will rekey and re-issue sanitized snapshots and mark the original as deprecated; we will never leave an unremediated backup that contains your objects. We will flag and list any snapshots we could not fully delete for legal review.

2) Hashes: yes — the manifest will include SHA256 digests for every object ID deleted. We will store the digest in our internal audit index and publish the signed PDF receipt with the digest list.

3) Signature: Tessa will coordinate the Ops signature; I will countersign the acceptance receipt once you confirm deletion.

Risk controls and rollback:
- The delete pipeline is irreversible for affected objects once the manifest is signed; if you want a short grace period we can hold the signed receipt for 24 hours before publishing.
- We will provide runbook excerpts and command hashes used during deletion for your audit team.

We will proceed tonight at 22:00 PT. Expect the confirmation artifacts to land in your shared drive link (Drive: Zephyr > Compliance > Erasure-2026) and also an emailed PDF from our ops mailbox within 14 hours of start.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
